title: Chapter 535
paragraphs: Chapter 535
Chapter 145. Omen (4)
Despite the death of Myron and Midor, no one was disturbed.
The fleet of 33 ships was aglow with a red light.
A powerful magic that seemed impossible to deal with was resonating, threatening to tear the sky apart.
'So this was why the Emperor and Laramakua were so confident.'
Dante had defeated the vanguard, and the Bamel Alliance, the Dragon Knights, and the Swordsmen had crushed the first reinforcements.

The major victories they had achieved in the early and middle stages of the battle were now insignificant. While the Sword Emperor's camp was still intact, it was impossible to confront over 60 Spirit Armies.
'Even if the resurrected Spirit Armies have less power than when they were alive...'
Each unit of magic was close to 9-star in size, and the ships powered by it would perform far stronger than the ones used by the previous reinforcements.
The ships of the Red Fleet opened their maws, revealing their main cannons.
"Enya, hold on tight. The magic of the mirror is infinite. In theory, we can handle thousands of them. Increase the strength of the shield, open your eyes, breathe...."
Although Beris said this, he knew that Enya was already at her limit. Blood flowed from her mouth and nose, and her body was trembling.
Enya barely nodded.
"I, I can do it, Keuk, Keuk! I'll make it!"
Just as Jin yelled with all his might, the ships fired their cannons.
Although it was no match for Kojek's golden cannon, the 33 cannon shots mixed with the red energy unique to the Spirit Army magic seemed enough to destroy the Sword Emperor's Castle in an instant.
The reason why the Sword Emperor's Castle did not collapse at the moment the first salvo was fired was thanks to Enya.
She had succeeded in controlling the mirror, and the near-infinite magic-infused flame-retardant shield perfectly blocked the bombardment.
"You, you did well, Enya!"
Even Beris, in his pride, embraced Enya.
'But it's over, if I try to control the mirror one more time... I'll end up like me.'
Enya's body, which he felt in his arms, was hot like a burning coal. Her spasms and severe bleeding quickly dyed Beris's clothes red.
"Huk, Huk! Hu!"
Enya also had a hunch that if she continued to use the mirror, she would either die or never be able to use magic again.
Nevertheless, she grabbed the mirror again.
"Enya, you can't go any further."
"If I, don't, then......"
Too many people would die.
That feeling was what made Enya move again.
Most of the people who had gathered for the Sword Emperor's Castle were strangers to Enya, yet she didn't hesitate to risk her life to save them.
Because she thought it was the right thing to do.
The frigates seemed unable to reload their main cannons as quickly as Kojek.
While that was somewhat of a relief, their means of attack were not limited to fleet bombardment.
Red Abyss.
The circular magic of the Spirit Armies began to spread across the sky and the ground.
[Annihilate the enemies of Ziefl...]
[The lord wants the white stone. Kill and find it...!]
The gloomy voices of the Spirit Armies spread. They all had the same voice, and their speech was somewhat slurred, like someone intoxicated.
'The density of the Red Abyss is lower than I remember.'
These elements were not difficult to infer from.
The same voice and the resonance unique to the resurrected dead, and the diminished magic compared to the original.
There was a clear gap between the summoned Spirit Armies and the ones Jin had encountered in the past.
Of course, this was a slight downgrade compared to the Red Abyss Jin had previously experienced, but by normal standards, it was literally a grand magic.
It seemed as if blood-red rain was falling.
Red magic turned into swords and chains, battering the ground. Most were blocked by the fire-retardant shield, but Enya was still taking hits.
Murakan also spread a curtain of spiritual power to protect the ground, and Quicantel roared and scattered the power of time.
But the magic was too massive.
Along with the Red Abyss, various attack-type magics were pouring out from all over the sky.
Elemental magics such as Hell Wind, Flame Jade, and Ice Sword were being fired, breaking the fire-retardant shield.

The Dragon Knights and Swordsmen were trying to counterattack, but it wasn't easy. Hiran's final machines were offset by countless magics before they reached the enemies, and even when they barely approached, they were often pushed back by concentrated attacks.
The Spirit Armies' magic was seeping through the cracks in the fire-retardant shield.

Their magic didn't distinguish between the Emperor's army and the Sword Emperor's army. As a result, the Emperor's army suffered more damage than the Sword Emperor's army, which was protected by the Bamel Alliance.
"You crazy guys, we're allies...!"
"Kuak!"
A gigantic cauldron boiling with screams and explosions.
The battlefield was changing again, and Jin had to make a decision.
'Mother... isn't thinking of joining the battle yet.'
Rosa and Runcandel were still not showing any signs of appearing.
The reason was clear.
'Mother is planning to appear when the white stone is about to be destroyed or looted, or when the Sword Emperor's Castle completely collapses and can no longer counterattack.'
Unlike Jin, Runcandel's goal was not to rescue the Sword Emperor's Castle.
The 'White Stone' was the case. For Runcandel, the sole purpose was to prevent Ziefl from profiting from that stone.

Ideally, neither side would obtain the White Stone and it would be destroyed - this would be the best outcome for Runcandel. After all, Ziefl knew exactly what to do with the stone, whereas Runcandel did not.
Also, the moment Runcandel directly intervenes, the risk of a full-scale war increases. Therefore, Rosa hoped that Jin would use Hyran to destroy the White Stone.
Therefore, the moment for Runcandel to appear was when the Sword Emperor's Castle was completely crushed and retreating.
Would they somehow grit their teeth and keep blocking?
Or, even if the Sword Emperor's Castle suffered severe damage, would they save the power of the Bamel Alliance and let Runcandel appear?
Jin chose the former.

It could not be said to be an efficient choice. There was a higher likelihood that it would be better in the current situation to let Runcandel step in, even if the Sword Emperor's Castle collapsed and thousands of knights died.
However, Jin believed that he should not use his friends and their lives as collateral. Some might ridicule it as naive and dull-hearted, but he was confident that it was the right choice.
In other words, Jin was making a choice for his friends and people, while Rosa was making a choice for Runcandel.
'If I had only thought about Runcandel's benefit from the beginning, I would have raised Runcandel's flag as the Twelfth Knight, not as the Bamel Alliance.'
Why this was the right choice, as always, could be proven.
'The Myung Wang Gun Rim Sword is not an option.'
With the Myung Wang Gun Rim Sword, it would be possible to penetrate the protective barrier of more than 60 Spirit Armies and destroy the fleet.
However, once the Myung Wang Gun Rim Sword was unfolded, there was 'no next'.
As the Supreme Commander of the Bamel Alliance, Jin had to observe the beginning and end of this war and give judgement and orders.
He had to protect the flame of Hyran, no matter how much Ziefl, Runcandel, or any other force stirred up chaos.
Only Jin, unlike them, was hoping for Hyran's survival, not the White Stone.
Jin's eyes bulged as he called for Shuri. Shuri, who had been sweeping the battlefield with Dante still in the Sword Emperor's Castle, rushed to Jin's side like an arrow.
"To the city walls!"
[Mya Mya!]
As Shuri sprinted at full speed, the Spirit Armies' magic began to concentrate on Jin. Over half of the fire-retardant shield had been destroyed and couldn't protect Jin.
"Protect the Lord!"
[Help the little one!]
The unmanned soldiers of the Bamel Alliance, including the Balkas and Prochi siblings, rushed towards Jin, opened the way, and repelled the magic.
Jin also swung his sword wildly, and Shuri roared and fired rays from her eyes.
Several attack magics and rays struck Shuri directly, but they couldn't break through the curse of immortality.
Even amidst all this, Enya continued to try to control the mirror.
"Enya! Stop, you're going to die!"
"Ha, haa, people keep dying...!"
"Jin is coming, if you go wrong, it could endanger his heart. That could end up killing even more people! Is that what you want!"
If it hadn't been for Beris's words, Enya might have reinforced the fire barrier once more and met her death.
In the end, Enya, who had put down the mirror, grinded her teeth, her face smeared with tears and blood.
"They're... such bad people. It seems like there's nothing but bastards in the Empire and Zipple, Ka-haack!"
"Cough!"
A red spear made of magic was driven into the ground where Enya and Beris stood.
The first one fortunately only destroyed the wall, but the second one that followed immediately was aimed right at them.
At that moment, Shuri jumped over the wall, and Jin cut off the red spear that fell on the two.
"Master Jin...!"
Jin took off his robe and wrapped it around Enya's shoulder.
Enya burst into tears at his back. Because beyond his steel-like back and below the wall, the corpses of Hyran knights were piled up.
Enya was not as strong as Jin. Facing those many deaths was a terrible pain in itself.
"You did well, Enya, and Beris. If it were me, I would have fallen short."
Upon hearing those words, Enya lost consciousness.
Jin picked up the mirror on the ground.
"Beris, ride Shuri. Take Enya to the healers, and tell Dante. We don't know much about that white stone, but never even think about using that damned thing."
Dante, contrary to Jin's worries, didn't know how to use the white stone yet.
But as the war escalated, Dante clearly heard a dark voice whispering to him.
It was the voice of the white stone.
Come to think of it.
Even when they got the mirror, Zipple had trampled on countless colonists, seeking only power.
Now it was Jin's turn to trample on them with the power that Zipple had ultimately missed.
A magic circle formed under Jin's feet.
Ka-aa-aaang...!
And with the unique sharp rotation sound of the counterflow magic, the scene of the counter-celestial sphere rising into the sky followed.

It looked as if the moon was right in front of him. The counter-celestial, far beyond the limit of Jin's magical power, showed a growing figure every time it blinked its eyes, absorbing the magical power of the red abyss.
"This is the counter-celestial with infinite magical power. Even if your magic power is great, I wonder if you can show off in front of this."
